name: tw02-dbg-noon-back
js: v.state.heading = 0; v.state.bankDeg = 0; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const ob = (v.state.heading + (v.state.seat === 'right' ? 90 : -90)) * Math.PI / 180; const b0 = Math.atan2(-Math.cos(ob), Math.sin(ob)); const L = [[-22,230,0.1,0.35],[-12,300,0.9,0.5],[-4,420,0.55,0.62],[4,520,0.3,0.45],[10,600,0.7,0.55],[17,690,0.2,0.4],[22,350,0.45,0.8],[-17,380,0.65,0.15]]; v.farTowers.override = L.map(([a,d,s,age],i) => { const b = b0 + a*Math.PI/180; const R = 1.3*(4.5+2*s); return {id:'d'+i, x: Math.cos(b)*d, z: Math.sin(b)*d, R, top: age < 0.2 ? 9.5 : 13.5+1.5*s, Ra: R*(2+2.6*s), dirX: Math.cos(1+i*2.3), dirZ: Math.sin(1+i*2.3), thick: 2+1.6*s, col: age>0.75?0.3:1, anvil: age<0.2?0:1, seed: (i*0.377+s)%1}; }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return 'active=' + v.farTowers.active + ' scissor=' + v.farTowers.scissor.toArray().join(',');
